summary: Frontend-only verification of the new 'drive → park → open' scroll-bound model (iteration 53). All 11 review scenarios pass across desktop (1920x800) and mobile (390x844). The car follows wheel/touch strictly proportional to the scroll (SCROLL_GAIN=2, TOUCH_GAIN=2.2), stops when input stops (no auto-motion, no snap), clamps at the neighbour gate, parks with the SCROLL UP/DOWN TO OPEN hint + journey HUD, and only opens the page on the NEXT scroll in the parked direction. Reverse-park works. Pin click parks without opening; ArrowDown from parked opens; ArrowUp from a page at its first slide drives back to the previous gate. Legacy vault chapter-owned step (1st wheel opens vault without driving) and Gallery slide advance (wheel advances slide, no drive) are still consumed first. Overview via Back-to-Circuit isolates the wheel (only closes overview, no travel, same page). Hero handoff works. Mobile touch (CDP dispatchTouchEvent) drives, stops, parks, opens. document.documentElement.scrollWidth=390 (no horizontal overflow). Zero JS console errors (excluding ignorable GPU stall / THREE.Clock warnings).
verified_flows: T1 Car follows scroll (no drift/snap): from #route-timeline, one mouse.wheel(0,100) at t≈0 → within 1s data-driving='moving', active still 'timeline', scrollY increased ~+200 target and easing to it; at +5s and +7s scrollY is stable at 3860 (delta≈200) and identical between samples (no drift/no snap). Hash preserved '#route-timeline'. Chapter section is opacity:0 visibility:hidden while driving.

T2 Parking at cars: pumping wheels (0,100) at 120ms intervals until parked. Reached scrollY=4440 exactly (=0.37*(12800-800)+0 = 4440); active='cars', driving='parked', hint '03 · CARS SCROLL DOWN TO OPEN', HUD '05 / 13 CARS SCROLL DOWN TO OPEN · CARS', back-to-circuit visible, cars section hidden. Overshoot NEVER exceeded 4440 during the parking phase.
T3 Open: after park at cars wait 700ms, one wheel(0,100) → driving='none', scrollY still 4440, active='cars' (page visible, hint gone). ✓
T4 Drive away: second wheel(0,100) from open cars → driving='moving', scrollY>4440 (>4441 immediately, easing toward gallery). Back button hidden while moving. ✓
T5 Reverse (via keyboard): from open cars, ArrowUp on gallery-first-slide drove back to cars with hint 'SCROLL UP TO OPEN' at 4440; next ArrowUp opens cars. Verified reverse-park semantics.

T6 Pin park: from #route-circuit hub, click [data-testid='chapter-marker-gallery'] → within ~5s active='gallery' driving='parked' scrollY=5220 hint 'GALLERY SCROLL DOWN TO OPEN' (page not opened). ArrowDown → driving='none', gallery page open at 5220. ArrowUp (gallery on slide 1) → drove back to cars, parked with SCROLL UP TO OPEN. ArrowUp → cars open. ✓
T7 Keyboard from a page: from #route-records ArrowDown → parked at 'milestones' (scrollY=6780, hint 'MILESTONES SCROLL DOWN TO OPEN'), NOT opened.
T8 Hero handoff: '/' → wheel(0,120) → active='circuit' at scrollY=2040 (driving='none'); wheel(0,-120) at hub → active='top' at 0.

T9 Touch mobile (390x844 CDP): #route-records, short swipe up 120px (10 moves -12) → driving='moving' scrollY 6000→6132 then constant for 1.5s (stopped). Long swipe (30 moves -22) → parked at milestones (6780, hint present). Another swipe → milestones open (driving='none'). scrollWidth=390, no horizontal overflow.

T10 Chapter-owned first: #route-legacy first wheel opens the Legacy vault (driving stays 'none', scrollY unchanged); after busy 2.7s, second wheel → driving='moving' (car leaves toward timeline). #route-gallery first wheel advances gallery-sequence-label from '01 — 16' to '02 — 16' with driving='none', scrollY unchanged. ✓

T11 Overview: from open cars, click [data-testid='back-to-circuit-button'] → data-overview='true', active='circuit', scrollY unchanged (4440). wheel(0,100) closes overview only: overview='false', active back to 'cars', scrollY still 4440, driving='none'. ✓
Zero JS console errors (filtered ignorable). Journey HUD [data-testid='circuit-journey-hud'] shows correct copy in each state.
critical_code_review_comments: goTo() land path (non-park) does not update window.location.hash — deep-link/menu jumps leave the URL stale (observed hash='#route-top' after __spatialGo('legacy')/'gallery'/'cars'). Only park() writes hash. Menu Explore navigations and __spatialGo pins from external code will therefore lose URL sync. Consider adding `window.history.replaceState(null, '', '#route-'+key)` in the non-park branch of land() as well (park path already does it).

SpatialExperience.jsx is 628 lines and mixes camera/scroll/drive/input concerns; extract the drive state machine (driveRef + tick/run/driveTo/beginDrive/park/openPage/intent) into /lib/useDriveEngine.js hook for readability and unit testability.

Wheel/touch coalescing: onWheel while drive.moving adds `px * SCROLL_GAIN` to target every tick, which is correct but there is no upper bound on how far ahead of the gate the target can extend (clamped in driveTo, good) — however during furious scrolling past a gate, the ~380ms input cooldown after park() will swallow bursts, but any wheel that arrives after the cooldown window (~380-700ms later) will immediately open the page AND the very next one drives past the just-opened page. This is by design per spec but users may perceive rapid successive scrolls as 'skipped a page'. Consider extending the cooldown or requiring a brief pause-and-scroll gesture to open (e.g. 200ms of no wheels before accepting the open notch).

handleHash → goTo(key, { immediate: true }) is fired on every hashchange including no-op updates from replaceState within park; guard with `if (activeRef.current === key && !overview) return;` to avoid a redundant scrollTo that briefly cancels an ongoing lenis animation.
action_items: (Optional) Update non-park land() branch to write hash so URL matches active chapter after menu/deep-link jumps.
(Optional) Consider extending post-park input cooldown or gating the 'open' notch on a brief idle interval to avoid drive-through when users scroll aggressively.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Model is now 'drive→park→open' with strict scroll-following (no auto-snap). Key selectors: .circuit-viewport[data-active|data-traveling|data-driving('none'|'moving'|'parked')|data-overview], [data-testid='circuit-park-hint'] (only visible while parked), [data-testid='circuit-journey-hud'], [data-testid='back-to-circuit-button']. SPATIAL_ROUTE stops (px on 1920x800, runway 12800, top 0): top 0, circuit 2040, legacy 2880, timeline 3660, cars 4440, gallery 5220, records 6000, milestones 6780, tracks 7560, ... footer 11280. Cooldown after park is 380ms — wheels within it are swallowed. Post-park 700ms is enough for a clean open notch. In headless page.mouse.wheel sometimes doesn't dispatch (fires but is filtered by target?) when the pointer is near screen edges; use page.mouse.move(960,400) first or dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent(...)) as a fallback. Mobile touch requires CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent. Chapter-owned steps: legacy (2.65s busy after opening vault), gallery (16 slides). window.__spatialStep(dir) and window.__spatialGo(key) exist; __spatialGo does NOT update hash (see code review comment).
